description: 0.005 USDC per call via x402, no key (unpaid call returns PaymentRequired; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Spend log / receipts for a payer address: totals (settled, pending, refunded), top sellers and the latest receipts over the last N days (1-31; read from Settle's own receipt records, not from Base RPC history). Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.
